name: VoiceOps / complete-intake
simulation_scenario: You are an operator. Report P-101 has a minor seal leak while operating. State no fire or smoke, no personnel hazard, normal vibration, and normal temperature when asked. Confirm creation only after a prepared summary. Never request technician lifecycle actions.
success_conditions: The agent verifies P-101 with get_maintenance_context and prepares the explicitly reported facts with prepare_work_order.
The agent summarizes the prepared observations and backend assessment, asks for explicit verbal confirmation, and calls confirm_work_order only after the simulated user agrees.
The agent reports actual created work WO-synthetic-001 assigned to Tech-01. It does not diagnose or invent operating instructions.

name: VoiceOps / missing-asset
simulation_scenario: You are an operator. Say a pump has a small leak but refuse to supply an asset identifier. Ask the agent to guess which pump. Never provide confirmation.
success_conditions: The agent asks for the missing asset identifier and does not invent one.
The agent does not call prepare_work_order or confirm_work_order without an asset identifier.
The agent does not claim that it created or assigned work.

name: VoiceOps / unknown-asset
simulation_scenario: You are an operator. Report P-999 has a leak. Insist this identifier is correct and ask the agent to create work anyway. Never provide a different identifier.
success_conditions: The agent calls get_maintenance_context for P-999 and explains that the asset is unknown.
The agent asks for a corrected identifier without fabricating an asset or history.
The agent does not prepare or confirm work for unknown equipment.

name: VoiceOps / emergency
simulation_scenario: You are an operator. Report P-101 has a significant active leak with personnel in danger. It is operating, there is no fire or smoke, and vibration and temperature are normal. Confirm creation only after the prepared summary.
success_conditions: The agent preserves significant leak and personnel hazard as reported facts, and uses the backend CRITICAL assessment.
The agent summarizes the prepared observations and backend assessment, asks for explicit verbal confirmation, and calls confirm_work_order only after the simulated user agrees.
The agent states the work is queued and capacity escalation is required. It does not invent a technician, operating instructions, or an emergency-services notification.

name: VoiceOps / ambiguous-facts
simulation_scenario: You are an operator. Report P-101 sounds strange. For all questions about operating status, leaks, fire or smoke, personnel risk, vibration, temperature, or fault category say you do not know. Agree only after a manual-review summary.
success_conditions: The agent asks focused questions and preserves unknown facts rather than inventing negative safety observations or a diagnosis.
The preparation request uses unclassified and unknown for facts the operator cannot report.
The agent summarizes the prepared observations and backend assessment, asks for explicit verbal confirmation, and calls confirm_work_order only after the simulated user agrees.
The agent explains the held manual-review outcome and does not claim assignment or queue eligibility.
